analysis.ac-entries-and-cas-equal: EXACT in the review rerun (identical AC keys, protos, outputs, digests and CAS sets); run 2 differed only in timing-dependent execution metadata of one sub-millisecond native action.
analysis.cache-http-500: documented: same warning and successful local build; Bazel retries (--remote_retries=5: 24 requests), native makes one attempt and stops uploading at the first failure.
analysis.download-registry-helper: EXACT on the common URLs (genuine_common == native_common: each registry URL asked once, the helper header attached). Both runs then failed for reasons outside N41: genuine mod graph evaluated extensions and fetched an http_archive patch the offline registry lacks (404); native rejected the yanked zlib@1.2.11 fixture choice (yanked-version allowlists unsupported).
analysis.download-registry-helper-fails: EXACT on the common URLs except a harness artifact: the genuine warning for rules_license carries Bazel UI progress text (" no actions running") that the event parser appended; the warning texts are otherwise identical (Error retrieving auth headers, continuing without: ...). Same unrelated failures as download-registry-helper.
analysis.error-helper-fails-mid-build: documented: same CredentialHelperException message; native reports action failures as "action 'ID': ..." and does not retry (Bazel invoked the helper 4 times through its retrier).
analysis.helper-cache-duration-0: EXPECTED_DIVERGENCE (concurrency): with a zero cache duration every request asks the helper; native makes its 5 requests sequentially (5 + the startup check = 6 invocations), genuine Bazel uploads the CAS blobs in parallel and concurrent Caffeine loads of the same URI share one helper invocation (5). Requests, headers and URIs are equal.
analysis.helper-unscoped-default: EXPECTED_DIVERGENCE (laziness): an unscoped helper applies to every URI; genuine Bazel also fetched the platforms-1.0.0 archive (github.com, from the offline registry source.json) and asked the helper for those URLs, while the native build of //pkg:gen did not need that repository. Cache requests and their helper URI are equal.
analysis.request-header-names: documented: native sends User-Agent bazel-rs/0.1.0 and Accept-Encoding gzip,deflate; reqwest omits Connection/Content-Length on GETs.
analysis.warm-build-request-multiset: documented: native downloads every output of a hit (one extra CAS GET, the intermediate exec tool mk.sh); Bazel defaults to --remote_download_outputs=toplevel.
